The Shenlong Gang is
a small sect of the
Changbai Mountains,
little known in the
martial world, but
medicine and
antidotes are its
specialty: win its
help, and your life
gains an extra
safeguard. One of
its past chiefs was
a man of rare
genius. He pondered
for seven years
beside the Heavenly
Lake, and from the
changes of sun and
moon he grasped a
profound art, the
Fire Dragon, which
became the gang's
treasure. But the
chiefs after him
were mediocre: the
manual was handed
down, yet no one
ever mastered it.
